title: Diagnostic: No Default Args in Protocols
hints: Default argument values aren't allowed in protocol requirements.
Add `= false` to the `urgent` parameter in the protocol.
`func send(_ message: String, urgent: Bool = false)`.
jsBridge: The compiler forbids default arguments in protocol requirements, because defaults are a caller-side convenience and the requirement is the implementation contract. Use a protocol extension overload instead.

compass.q: Why can TS optional parameters live in interfaces while Swift defaults can't live in protocols?
